brief:
A 14-year-old was shot in the upper thigh with live ammunition, the Palestinian Ministry of Health reported via the Ma'an news agency. Multiple cases of asphyxiation were also treated at Palestine Medical Complex as a result of the military operation in Ramallah and Al-Bireh.

The injuries came during what the health ministry described as an Israeli occupation assault on the two Palestinian cities.

title: Israeli military operation injures 14-year-old in Ramallah
